summary: Verified the June 2026 additions end-to-end. BACKEND: 106/107 tests pass (94 pre-existing + 10 new in test_start_end_and_seatmap_slots.py + 3 new extras I added in test_start_end_extras.py covering PUT-bumps-stale-end-date, cancel-releases-seatmap+slot-inventory, and migration-002-idempotency). The single failure (test_booked_seats_endpoint_filters_by_slot) is the known /register 429 rate-limit when run in the full-suite; verified PASSING solo. Migration 002 is idempotent — second run reports 'Updated: 0'. FRONTEND: EventForm exposes start-date-field + end-date-field (no more free-text YYYY-MM-DD) and seat_map booking type shows the 'Time Slots (optional)' section with seatmap-add-slot-btn + seatmap-slot-input-{i}. Booking flow for seat_map+time_slots correctly forces the user to pick a slot FIRST (header sub 'Pick a showing'), then reveals the seat grid with a 'Showing: <slot>' pill. Switching slots refreshes per-slot availability (verified: A1 booked in Matinee 3PM shows aria-disabled=true, while the same A1 in Evening 8PM is available). Event detail and ticket screens render the eventDateRange helper (e.g. 'Sep 1, 08:00 AM – Sep 2, 08:00 AM'). No red-screen errors; only harmless RN-web deprecation console warnings for shadow*/textShadow*.

minor.issue: Rate-limit (5/minute) causes the last test in test_start_end_and_seatmap_slots.py to fail when the suite is executed back-to-back. Passes solo. Consider raising the limit in the test env or making the tests re-use one organizer/consumer token.

ui_bugs.issue: When 0 seats are selected for a paid seat_map event the footer shows 'Total: Free' rather than '₹0' or '—'. Non-blocking cosmetic — not a regression, but confusing on a ₹100/seat event.

action_items: Optional: fix the 'Total: Free' cosmetic — show '₹0' or 'Select seats' when nothing is picked on a paid seat_map event.
Optional: bump the /register rate-limit in TEST env or refactor test_start_end_and_seatmap_slots.py to reuse tokens so full-suite runs cleanly without needing solo re-runs. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2008 lines — flagged in iterations 10 & 11 and still not split. Recommend extracting bookings / events / auth into separate routers.

DateTimeField.tsx web fallback uses TextInput with `type` prop (see line 220-221 // @ts-expect-error). Works fine on rn-web today but is brittle if react-native-web ever tightens its prop types. Consider forwarding via `nativeID` or a small `Platform.OS === 'web'` div fallback.
